title: BK Vinnitsya clinch 1 League title
description: BK Vinnitsya outgunned Rivne 2 80-62 in the Final game and clinched 1 League title. Yuriy Shkondya (188-G-1995) finished with 26 points and 8 rebounds for the champions. He was named the MVP. Evgeniy Romanov (185-G-1999) top scored with 33 points for BK Vinnitsya. Oleksandr Ponosov (187-G-2004, agency: BIG) answered with 16 points for Rivne 2. Poltava earned the third position as they held off BK Khmelnitskyi-2 73-69. Sergiy Melnyk (190-G-2001) tossed in 24 points and grabbed 7 rebounds for the winners.
